verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's architecture docs state outright "VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM." The overview adds that each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with "strong security boundaries" for running untrusted code. That is a documented VM-level boundary, and no community evidence contradicts it. However, the docs mostly describe it as a container and give little detail on the boundary itself. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the VM/hypervisor technology and threat model, clarification of the container-vs-VM layering, independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary.
